Claim opened after a low-speed head-on collision reported by the insured driver, who is named on the policy. The

Reviewed the police report and confirmed with the responding officer that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time

10/21/2024
Two independent witnesses gave statements that agree with the sequence of events described by both drivers.
Scene photos were received and reviewed.
11/11/2024
Inspected the vehicle damage. The front-end damage is consistent with the impact described and with the speed
reported. A few old scratches elsewhere on the body may predate this crash and have been noted separately.
11/23/2024
Nothing in the records suggetss the damage occurred before the policy coverage began. Coverage confirmed as in
force on the date of loss.
01/02/2025
Claimant contacted me and provided a few additional details about the collision, including where the vehicle was
positioned after impact. The core account has not changed from the original report.
02/06/2025
Reviewed the medical records. The reported neck and back strain is a plausible injury for a collision of this type. No
prior injury to the same body area is known from the claimant's history or the records obtained.
03/07/2025
Treatment followed a usual course of physical therapy and follow-up visits. Symptoms have ipmroved steadily and
the frequency of treatment has tapered off as recovery progressed.
03/30/2025
Asked the claimant whether any earlier neck or back complaints existed. The claimant denied prior issues, and no
contrary recrods have been found to date.
03/31/2025
Current assessment: the accident, vehicle damage, and reported injury are consistent with each other. Treatment is
tpaering as expected. File remains open pending final medical updates.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
